item: KV boot fix B: controller boot window (HBM calendar sealed only after boot -> cold-boot scratch check deadlock)
rtl_files: rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static_core.sv (legacy ci controller: new u_ctl port connected, no window)
design: boot_win = 1 from scheduler reset until the first static_cmd_owner (first compiled layer go), never reopens; u_ctl boot_window pin flop -> ot_qkd_static_kv_timing boot_static_col: s_go = legal_static && (reserved_static_col || boot); col_boot marks unreserved columns; expected_sr (write observer) = reservation+4 | col_boot+1 (one flop); boot read nominal raw slot = col_boot + 25 edges (= RAW 27 after the virtual reservation)
hw_cost_per_pc: about 28 flops (boot_win, bootwin_q, col_boot, boot_raw[25]; expected_sr pipe 4->3 + expected_sr_q), x128 PCs ~3.6k flops; kvpc tile RTL changed -> its closed view must be re-hardened

lockstep_gate.eq_runs: 12 (PC 0/45/127 x jitter 0/16 x PRE 0/3000 without pre-ownership static words): 0 mismatches, 144186-170088 checks each, compiled calendar 4 frames + 6000 stress edges
lockstep_gate.dis_runs: 2 (window disabled, 3000 edges random pre-ownership static words): 0 mismatches in every phase
lockstep_gate.act_run: window as built, random pre-ownership static words: 80 boot columns, 24681 pre-phase differences (the intended change)
lockstep_gate.mutant_never_closes: FAIL LOCKSTEP 51483 mismatches, 203 boot columns after ownership

pcpart_gate.B_hck_is_clk: 4/4 slices done & ok (sdo 1111 soo 1111 sfo 0000), 0 controller faults, PHY 8 WR + 8 RD
pcpart_gate.B_real_hbm_clock: PC0 / PC2 done & ok; PC1 / PC3 f_raw: each PHY return reaches the controller twice (rv 3 vs 2 PHY returns) because kv3_pc_part registers the PHY po/pi boundary lanes (ot_dp_st) on the core clock clk while po/pi are HBM-domain (bind clock finding, not B)
pcpart_gate.mutants: ORIG and WOFF: no column ever issues, all slices TIMEOUT (cause 2) at ~20190; NOOBS: 4/4 controllers write-observer fault; NORAW: 4/4 controllers f_raw
pcpart_gate.bench_fix: qkd_hbm3e_phy_pc4_bench WR data captured WL=5 hck edges after the WR column (as-built po write latency); the model had stored the column edge's stale wd (cause 3 data mismatch)

cycles.hck_is_clk: first static word at controller 193, WR column 213, RD column 237, phase-2 WR 301 / RD 325, all 4 slices done&ok 359-373 => 179-193 core cycles (~0.16 us) after boot_go
cycles.real_hbm_clock_pc0: WR column 218, RD 243, WR 316, RD 342, done&ok 385 => 205 core cycles (~0.17 us) after boot_go
cycles.original: never completes: TIMEOUT 20000 cycles per slice, then HOST never releases die reset (deadlock)
cycles.window_length: HBM reset release -> first compiled layer go (host boot order: boot check ~0.2k cycles + die reset release + boot image load + seal); not a fixed count, closes on a compiler-known event
